questions.question: After you connect the air lines to the trailer, what should you do next?

options.text: Turn on the air supply to the trailer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn on the air supply to the trailer.
questions.explanation: When coupling trailers safely, turn on the air supply to the trailer after connecting the air lines.

questions.question: How does a truck's weight affect stopping distance?

options.text: It is less important than the type of cargo.

questions.explanation: A truck's weight greatly affects how long it takes to stop. Heavier trucks need more braking power to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: After coupling, how much space should be between the upper and lower fifth wheel?
questions.explanation: When inspecting couplings before a trip, make sure there is no space between the upper and lower fifth wheel.

questions.question: In a sudden turn, which trailer is most likely to tip over?
questions.explanation: Turn gently and smoothly. Quick turns while pulling trailers are dangerous and can cause the last trailer to roll over.

questions.question: What should a driver of a baffled tank be most careful about?
questions.explanation: Baffles stop liquid from moving forward and backward, but not side-to-side. Side-to-side movement can cause rollovers.

questions.question: Why are roads especially slippery when it first starts to rain?

options.text: Rain mixes with oil on the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Rain mixes with oil on the road.
questions.explanation: When rain first starts, it mixes with oil that has dripped on the road. This creates a very slippery surface.

questions.question: How can you check that air reaches all trailers before a trip?

options.text: Check for moving air inside each trailer.
Listen for air at the rear shut-off valve.
Feel for air at the front shut-off valve.

questions.correctAnswerText: Listen for air at the rear shut-off valve.
questions.explanation: Build air pressure, then send air to the emergency and service lines. Open the shut-off valves at the rear of the last trailer. If air comes out, the system is working.

questions.question: When your engine runs a pump for compressed gas delivery, when should you turn it off?

options.text: Either before or after unhooking the hoses.

questions.explanation: Turn off the engine after finishing the product transfer but before you disconnect the hoses.

questions.question: How can you use less brakes when going down a hill?
questions.explanation: Before going downhill, slow down and shift to a lower gear. This helps control your speed without using the brakes too much. Using too much brake can overheat them and reduce stopping power.

questions.question: In wet conditions, what does a lack of spray from other vehicles' tires mean?

options.text: Ice has formed on the road.
The spray is stuck under the vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Ice has formed on the road.
questions.explanation: When it is wet, other vehicles normally create spray. If you see no spray, ice has likely formed. Be extra careful in these conditions.

questions.question: What is a Class 1 hazardous material?
questions.explanation: Class 1 hazardous materials are explosives. Examples include ammunition, dynamite, and fireworks.

questions.question: When carrying Division 1.1, 1.2, or 1.3 explosives, where should you NOT park your vehicle?
questions.explanation: Do not park a vehicle carrying Division 1.1, 1.2, or 1.3 explosives within 300 feet of a bridge, tunnel, or building. Exception: You can park briefly to refuel or perform other needed vehicle operations. Never park within 5 feet of the road.

questions.question: When are you most likely to encounter strong winds?
questions.explanation: Strong winds make it hard to keep your vehicle in its lane. You are especially likely to face strong winds when driving out of a tunnel.

questions.question: If your tank vehicle spills its cargo, what may happen?

options.text: You may have to pay for cleanup costs.
You are not responsible if someone else loaded the tank.
You must notify the local conservation department.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may have to pay for cleanup costs.
questions.explanation: It is illegal to drive a leaking tank. If you do, you may be responsible for paying to clean up the spilled material.

questions.question: Which surface is the most slippery?
questions.explanation: Wet ice forms when the weather is warm enough to slightly melt the ice. Wet ice is much more slippery than dry ice.
